azure-storage-account-blob-public.description: Storage account with blob public access allowed
azure-storage-account-blob-public.rationale: Public blob access risks data exfiltration.

azure-storage-account-no-soft-delete.remediation: Enable blob soft-delete with 7+ day retention.

azure-sqldatabase-no-encryption.description: Azure SQL Database without transparent data encryption (TDE)
azure-sqldatabase-no-encryption.rationale: Data at rest must be encrypted.
azure-sqldatabase-no-encryption.remediation: Enable TDE with service-managed key or customer key.

azure-network-security-group-open.description: NSG allows inbound traffic from 0.0.0.0/0 on sensitive ports
azure-network-security-group-open.rationale: Unrestricted ingress to admin ports is a critical exposure.
azure-network-security-group-open.remediation: Restrict SSH/RDP/3389 inbound to bastion or VPN CIDR.
